cards.title: Three irresistible things
cards.text: Tell your person three little things you find irresistible about them.

cards.title: Our tiny adventure
cards.text: Describe a playful mini-adventure you would love to share together.

cards.title: The smile effect
cards.text: Tell them about a moment when their smile changed your day.

cards.title: A stolen kiss
cards.text: Describe how you would steal a kiss if they were beside you and wanted one too.

cards.title: Flirty weather report
cards.text: Write a silly weather forecast for your next date, with a chance of kisses.

cards.title: Your personal theme song
cards.text: Choose a song that reminds you of them and explain your favorite connection.

cards.title: A very serious award
cards.text: Invent a funny award for your person and write a tiny acceptance speech for them.

cards.title: Meet-cute, take two
cards.text: Reimagine your first meeting as a sweet romantic-comedy scene.

cards.title: A pocket-sized love note
cards.text: Write a love note short enough to hide in their pocket.

cards.title: Dream breakfast
cards.text: Describe the breakfast you would make for them and the note you would leave.

cards.title: Only we understand
cards.text: Share an inside joke or a funny memory that belongs to the two of you.

cards.title: The compliment remix
cards.text: Compliment them without using the words beautiful, cute, or amazing.

cards.title: Our next date title
cards.text: Give your next imaginary date a movie title and a playful one-sentence plot.

cards.title: A little happy memory
cards.text: Describe one memory together you would happily relive.

cards.title: A text from the future
cards.text: Write a sweet message from your imagined next holiday together.

cards.title: Five-word flirting
cards.text: Write three flirty messages of exactly five words each.

cards.title: You make ordinary special
cards.text: Tell them about an ordinary activity that would be better with them.

cards.title: The perfect hug
cards.text: Describe the hug you would send them across the distance.

cards.title: A playful invitation
cards.text: Invite them on an imaginary date using your most charmingly ridiculous line.

cards.title: One thing I notice
cards.text: Share a small detail about them you notice and appreciate.

cards.title: Where the next kiss lands
cards.text: Tell them where you would like your next kiss to happen, and why.

cards.title: Closer, if you want
cards.text: Describe a moment when you would like to pull them a little closer, if they want it too.

cards.title: A whispered confession
cards.text: Write one bolder, flirty thought you would whisper in their ear.

cards.title: The slow kiss
cards.text: Describe an imaginary slow kiss, focusing on the anticipation and how you would feel.

cards.title: A look across the room
cards.text: Describe the look you would give them across a room when you want a private moment together.

cards.title: Our private date
cards.text: Imagine an intimate date for just the two of you: setting, mood, and one wish.

cards.title: The butterflies confession
cards.text: Tell them something they do that gives you butterflies in a deliciously distracting way.

cards.title: A daring invitation
cards.text: Write a teasing invitation for a romantic moment they are completely free to accept or decline.

cards.title: Almost a kiss
cards.text: Describe the moment just before a kiss, when you both know what you want.

cards.title: Your kind of chemistry
cards.text: Share what makes the chemistry between you feel special, and a romantic moment you would like to explore together.
